name: Ignition Key
summary: At Sludge Fen, the Ignition Key is held by Supervisor Lugwizzle at the Venture Company drilling operation. Wizzlecrank needs it to unlock an advanced shredder's movement column and activate its controls.

sections.title: A Missing Piece of Espionage
sections.body: Sputtervalve of Ratchet sent an operative to steal a Venture Company shredder from Sludge Fen, but the plan stalled. The undercover pilot, Wizzlecrank, climbed into the cockpit and found the movement column locked. He pretended the machine had mechanical trouble so the foremen would not grow suspicious while he waited for someone to fetch the Ignition Key. Supervisor Lugwizzle keeps the key high atop the central oil derrick, where access to the shredder's arm, speed, and rotation controls is held.

faq.q: Where can the Ignition Key be found?
faq.answer: Supervisor Lugwizzle keeps the Ignition Key in the control room atop the oil derrick in Sludge Fen, where he oversees the drilling work.

faq.q: Why does Wizzlecrank need this specific key?
faq.answer: The advanced Venture Company shredder has a locked movement column. Without its ignition key, Wizzlecrank cannot control its rotation, speed, stability, or arm well enough to drive it away.
Sputtervalve, a goblin engineer in Ratchet, arranged the theft to obtain the Venture Company's superior engineering designs.

faq.q: What happens once the key is delivered?
faq.answer: With the key, Wizzlecrank unlocks the movement column and starts the shredder's engine. He must then race through Sludge Fen's hostile laborers to escape toward Ratchet.

angles.text: The Ignition Key unlocks a shredder with advanced controls, including speed regulation and fine arm movement that outclass typical goblin designs.
